deferred.name: typescript
deferred.reason: typescript-eslint (under eslint-config-next) accepts <6.1.0, still so in 8.72.1, until its 7.1 native-parser support lands (typescript-eslint#12803, open), and 7.0 publishes no JS API, which test/apiReport.ts uses; 6.0.3 is installed meanwhile

deferred.name: @babel/core
deferred.reason: under Babel 8 the React Compiler silently skips components with defaults in destructured parameters (react#37406, still open on 2026-11-06; neither 8.0.10 nor 8.1.0 touches it), and the editor build runs it through @rolldown/plugin-babel

acceptedAdvisories.reason: deepmerge 4.3.1 has no fixed version; only the shadcn CLI and @shadcn/registry 0.2.1 use it, merging a registry item's theme we chose into our own config, in dev. Watch @shadcn/registry for a release without it

minimatch <11.0.1 amplifies attacker-supplied glob patterns; only dev tooling has it (eslint 10.14, @eslint/config-array, typescript-eslint, the shadcn CLI through ts-morph), fed our own config, tsconfig and registry globs, and every one requires minimatch ^10, so only an overrides would fix it. Watch eslint, typescript-eslint and @ts-morph/common for a minimatch ^11 range
